parsed.notes: Covenants require total leverage below 3.75x and interest coverage above 3.00x under the New Tranche A Term Loan and New Revolving Facility. The Term Loan B net secured leverage ratio (0.99x vs 3.75x) is excluded: it only governs whether an Excess Cash Flow prepayment is required, and the filing states the Term Loan B Facility has no financial maintenance covenants.
